jobs.title: Senior QA Manager Automation & AI - Fully Remote
jobs.description: We’re looking for a hands-on, AI-driven Senior QA Manager to transform QA across our mobile, web, and instant games portfolio. Your mission is to build an AI-first QA environment, developing and orchestrating AI agents, automating testing workflows, and continuously reducing manual effort while improving quality and release speed. You’ll own QA automation across multiple games and platforms, combining technical execution, smart prioritization, and a strong drive for efficiency. Qualified candidates are expected to complete an assignment. Candidates must be based in the European Union. Your Role: Drive AI-first QA: Introduce AI tools, agents, and intelligent workflows to automate and continuously improve QA processes. Build & orchestrate AI agents: Automate test generation, execution, bug detection, regression testing, and reporting. Own QA automation: Develop scalable testing frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. Optimize efficiency: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate repetitive manual work, and measure improvements in speed, coverage, and quality. Manage multiple projects: Prioritize QA across games, platforms, and teams based on risk and business impact. Ensure release quality: Oversee testing, bug prioritization, release readiness, and live monitoring across devices and platforms. Collaborate & innovate: Work closely with developers, product teams, and external QA partners to continuously improve QA practices. Stay hands-on: Personally build, test, and implement automation solutions rather than just managing processes. Your Profile: 5+ years of QA experience in mobile, web, or instant games, preferably live-operated F2P titles. Strong hands-on automation skills, including frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or similar. Practical AI experience: Using LLMs, AI coding tools, and ideally building or orchestrating AI agents. Technical proficiency: Comfortable with scripting, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows. Game QA expertise: Understanding of Unity, device compatibility, SDKs, ads, IAPs, analytics validation, and performance testing. Monitoring & debugging: Experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, Datadog, or similar tools. Multi-project ownership: Able to prioritize, switch contexts quickly, and coordinate distributed teams or external QA vendors. Builder mindset: Proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and driven to replace manual processes with smarter solutions. Strong analytical and communication skills, including excellent English. Benefits: SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including: Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs . No crunch culture. No overtime Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind. SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “ Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. We believe in proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and with the mission to create fun and everlasting Instant Games. At SOFTGAMES, we believe that different perspectives and background in our teams contribute to the quality of our work. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion / worldview, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity. Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application together with your salary expectations and earliest possible start date. jobs.description: About the job Own the test strategy that proves Graphcore’s next generation drivers are production-ready. As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape how Graphcore validates complex device drivers and platform tools. You will bring technical depth across Linux kernels, drivers and systems software. Your work will help raise the quality bar for products that support the next generation of AI compute. You will influence design decisions, guide test infrastructure and drive reliability across the stack. You will design, build, execute and report tests across component, system and acceptance levels. You will debug difficult issues using hardware and software tools, simulators and emulators. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with broad reach. You will help teams move quickly while protecting production quality. The team and culture The Drivers QA team verifies low-level kernel drivers, user-space libraries and platform tools. Work spans component tests, user acceptance and full system validation. You will work directly with driver developers, hardware, firmware, ML stack, Kubernetes and cloud management teams. Decisions are made close to the technical detail, with engineers expected to speak up and own outcomes. The team values engineers who think big, act fast and take responsibility. You will mentor others, raise standards and turn hard system problems into lasting improvements. What we're looking for · Deep experience validating Linux kernels, device drivers or similar systems software · Strong C++ and Python test development skills · Experience with CI/CD, build tools and modern automated testing practices · Ability to debug complex issues across hardware, firmware, drivers and upper software layers · Proven ownership of technical work, priorities and delivery in an agile engineering setting · Clear communication skills, including the ability to document and explain complex technical concepts While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission This role is a Senior QA/Test Engineer specializing in Amazon Connect and contact center technology, responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across contact flows, routing, IVR/self-service, and AI-driven conversational agents. They validate legacy-to-Connect migrations, build and maintain manual and automated test suites (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) spanning UI, API, and serverless backend components, and ensure production readiness through cutover validation, monitoring verification, and incident triage. Beyond hands-on testing, they partner with engineers to shift quality left, run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, and contribute reusable test assets and mentorship to strengthen Caylent's contact center QA practice. Your Assignment Test Strategy & Contact Center Quality Design and execute test strategies for Amazon Connect implementations covering contact flows, routing logic, IVR/self-service, Cases/Tasks workflows, and Contact Lens configurations Build test plans that validate AI agent behavior: intent recognition accuracy, escalation paths, barge-in/fallback handling, hallucination guardrails, and multilingual/SSML voice interactions Validate legacy-to-Connect migrations (i.e. Avaya, Genesys, Connect, NICE) through parallel-run testing, flow conversion verification, and data migration validation Define and track quality metrics (defect density, test coverage, escape rate) and report on release readiness to delivery leads and customer stakeholders Hands-on experience with web application and web automation testing Manual, Automated & Full-Stack Testing Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated IVR test suites, using tools such as Cyara, Hammer, or Botium (preferred). Build, maintain, and execute manual and automated web application test suites, using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright (preferred). Build and maintain manual and automated test suites: Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium, integration tests against live Amazon Connect instances, and end-to-end tests of Amazon connect call flows. Test custom Agent Workspace experiences (Amazon Connect, Agent Assist) Validate serverless, event-driven backends (Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, Kinesis) with integration and contract tests Production Readiness & Operations Execute phased rollout and cutover validation for live contact centers, where testing gaps translate directly into missed calls and customer impact Verify monitoring and alerting coverage (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards) across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents prior to go-live Participate in production incident triage, reproducing defects and validating fixes across the contact center stack Perform security and compliance validation: least-privilege IAM checks, DevSecOps scan review, and encryption standard verification Collaboration & Practice Contribution Partner with engineers during development to shift testing left: pairing on test design, reviewing acceptance criteria, and flagging risk areas early Run UAT sessions with customer stakeholders, triage findings, and drive defects to resolution ahead of production cutovers Contribute reusable test assets (automated suites, test data sets, QA checklists) back to the CXE practice Mentor junior QA engineers on contact center testing patterns and Caylent's quality standards Your Qualifications 8+ years of QA/test engineering experience, including 3+ years testing contact center, CCaaS, or IVR/voice platforms Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect or a comparable CCaaS platform: contact flows, routing, Cases/Tasks, and reporting Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (Playwright E2E and API tests, Cypress, Selenium) for unit, integration, and E2E testing Experience testing serverless/event-driven AWS architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions) Working knowledge of conversational AI / voice testing considerations

jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together.
